title: Control the ideas, not the code - <antirez>
summary: Antirez argues developers should control the design ideas and QA rather than review AI-generated code line by line, while still advising juniors to learn programming.

assertions.quote: if you control the ideas of your software, looking at the code itself is suboptimal and often pointless.
Nobody should anymore look at this code, but only at the ideas the code contains.
How are you supposed to review 5k lines of code every day?
LLMs are very good at writing locally optimal code, and are worse (but improving) with big ideas.
Fable and GPT 5.6 reviews to the sorted sets memory saving are going to spot ways more errors and subtle race conditions
You have to understand how things work, what is the best design, how to reach a certain level of performance.
use LLMs to write a DESIGN.md file where each data structure is described in human language

verdicts.note: A workflow preference that has not been compared empirically against code review.
